summary: Inspected 10 representative files across both subdirectories (HOL-CSP_PTick/ and HOL_in_HOL_Deep_Infinity_ZFC/). All 27 files contain genuine formal mathematical content: definitions, lemmas, theorems, and proofs in Isabelle/HOL. The HOL-CSP_PTick/ files develop a tick-extended CSP process algebra with sequential composition, synchronization products, renaming, operational semantics, and deadlock/livelock analysis. The HOL_in_HOL_Deep_Infinity_ZFC/ files construct a set-theoretic model of HOL in ZFC, proving consistency of classical HOL with choice and Dedekind infinity. Even the session root HOL-CSP_PTick.thy contains executable formal commands (declare, unbundle) which per FILTER-007 excludes it from pure-import classification. No file meets the hard-exclusion bar of FILTER-002/FILTER-004.
